This fragrance captures the vibrance and warmth of royal courtyards. It is a scent rooted in memory. Composed to transition smoothly from fresh, fruity notes to a grounded woody base, Baraamda is a moderate projection of lasting fragrance suitable for daily use.

A warm, woody–floral fragrance, it opens with bright mango and citrus top notes, leading into a heart of magnolia, rose, pepper, and honey. The composition settles into a deep base of oud, amber, musk, and Mysore sandalwood, providing lasting warmth and balance.

SPECIFICATION
Unisex Fragrance
Woody–floral scents

Top Notes: Mango, Cypress, Lime, Peach
Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Rose Taif, Magnolia, Orris, Black Pepper
Base Notes: Mysore Sandalwood, Vanilla, Olibanum, Ambrette, Oud, Musk
